library_preparation_preflight.summary: spring-boot-resttestclient 4.1.1 declares only spring-boot-test, spring-boot-http-converter and spring-web. Its main APIs (RestTestClient, TestRestTemplate) also need spring-test and spring-boot-restclient, which are not declared as dependencies. No Docker image is needed, because tests can use a local JDK HttpServer or a MockMvc/MockRestServiceServer binding.

deterministic_setup.reason: RestTestClient and its bindings (bindToServer, bindToController, bindTo(MockMvc)) are built on spring-test. It is not a declared dependency of the artifact. 7.0.9 is the spring-framework.version managed by Boot 4.1.1.
TestRestTemplate builds on RestTemplateBuilder and the client customizers from this module. It is not a declared dependency of the artifact. The sibling test project uses it at the same Boot version.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Use the same build.gradle pattern as tests/src/org.springframework.boot/spring-boot-restclient: derive the version from tck.testedLibraryVersion, add the assertj-core test dependency, and use the conditional agent mode with a user-code-filter.json. Run the tests against an in-process server (com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer on port 0) or against MockMvc/MockRestServiceServer-style bindings. Do not use a Docker container. If the tests need JSON conversion, use spring-boot-http-converter, which is already transitive. Add a Jackson dependency only if the compile or run fails for lack of one, and match the version Boot 4.1.1 manages (Jackson 3 BOM 3.1.5). Exercise TestRestTemplate (exchange, getForEntity, postForObject, the builder and its client customizers) and RestTestClient (get/post, expectStatus, expectBody) with real request and response round trips.
risks: The extra dependency versions are inferred from Boot 4.1.1's BOM, not from a Gradle resolution run. Check them with a local compile.
TestRestTemplate and RestTestClient may need more transitive dependencies, such as an HTTP client or Jackson, which only a native-image run can show.
Reflection and proxy metadata from Spring Boot test autoconfiguration may be missing. Cover it with the agent-generated metadata, not extra setup.
